Type: round metal wire basket, set of two
Use: storing throws, magazines or plants; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: glam, contemporary, modern
Materials: metal wire and flat bands, brushed silver finish, solid metal base
Colors: champagne silver
Shape: tall open cylinder of horizontal wire rings with wide flat bands at top and middle, solid round base, light and airy
Feel: elegant, airy, polished
Goes with: white, grey or blush walls, glass, velvet, mirrored accents; glam or contemporary rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Metal Wire Baskets, Set of 2, 13.75"H and 11.75"H, Silver
product.description: A delightful mix of elegance and streamlined efficiency, this metal wire basket comes in a set of two and is the perfect addition to any living room, dining room, or kitchen. Spruce up your living space and add a bit of organizational structure with these lovely pieces. Small: 11.75"H x 12" diameter; Large: 13.75"H x 13.75" diameter Formed of silver finished metal wire Useful for storing small items This stunning work of craftsmanship showcases the perfect marriage of functionality and grace. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
